---
title: "electrode_anatomy_mapping"
output: html_document
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(glue)
luibrary(dplyr)

project_dir <- "~/Documents/repos/explant-seq"
mapping <- read_csv(glue("{project_dir}/data/metadata/electrode_anatomy_key.csv"))
electrodes <- read_csv(glue("{project_dir}/data/metadata/explant-seq_electrode_metadata_260616.csv"))

electrodes_mapped <- electrodes %>%
  mutate(
    electrode_root = electrode |> str_remove_all("\\s*\\(.*?\\)") |> str_remove_all("\\?") |> str_trim(),
    electrode_root  = str_sub(electrode_root, 2),
    lesion = ifelse(str_detect(electrode_root, "X"), "lesion", "")) %>%
  left_join(mapping %>% select(electrode_root, region), by = "electrode_root")

electrodes_mapped <- electrodes_mapped %>% select(sample_id, subject, electrode, laterality, region, lesion, hippocampus, ictal_involvement)
electrodes_mapped[is.na(electrodes_mapped)] <- ""
write_csv(electrodes_mapped, glue("{project_dir}/data/metadata/explant-seq_electrode_metadata_260617.csv"))
```
